newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY MIXED AGAINST UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY MIXED AGAINST UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed agaisnt hard currencies at the close of lacklustre interbank trade on Tuesday, foreign exchange dealers said.
"There was basically not much interbank activity today. It was practically a dead market," commented one dealer.

The local unit finished Tuesday's session a touch firmer on the U.S. dollar at 11.3050/3150 compared to Monday's 11.3085/3185 and also gained marginally on Germany's mark to 6.5495/5520 from 6.5515/5590.
It was little changed at 18.3360/3470 versus sterling from Monday's 18.3360/3590 but eased against the rand to 2.5410/5445 from 2.5390/5585.
